status: DRAFT PROTOCOL (2026-10-21 UTC), revised after the maintainer's H1 decision. NOT preregistered, NOT frozen, NOT funded. It is frozen only after arm B's corpus exists (its pack identities and B's measured accounting replace every estimate below), the maintainer approves it, and a separate paid authorization is issued. Revised 2026-10-22 after an independent review: whole-unit admission, isolation R0/R7/R9, target_quality v2, the matching rule fixed and its values provisional, and the floor/resolution statistics (docs/stages/stage-2/reasoning_data/H1.md section 10).
question: With the same D4 initialization, the same recovery objective and a pre-defined matched training budget, does replacing the historical corpus_v2 data with a verified teacher-native reasoning corpus improve the student's actual reasoning CORRECTNESS in its own generations -- not only the completeness of its answers?
what_it_is: a TREATMENT comparison of two complete data schemes: content, quality and task distribution change together. Not attributable to correctness filtering alone; not a mixture experiment.

A.scheme: corpus_v2 (historical): hygiene acceptance, uniform six-way token mixture over code, gsm8k, multihop_qa, openmath, rag_evidence, tool_calling
A.sessions: every corpus_v2 UNIT none of whose sessions fails isolation rule R2: the 28 flagged sessions exclude their 28 units (30 sessions); a unit is never trained on in part (audit/asset_audit.json :: isolation.corpus_v2_sessions; pack_dry_run.old_arm_isolation_exclusion)
A.cut: 2.96M unique supervised tokens by the shared builder (pack_dry_run.OLD_ARM_SPEC); measured: 3,150 units, 3,312 sessions, 2,960,182 U, 1,459 blocks (plans/h1_accounting.json :: arm_A)
A.not_reused: no historical E1 result stands in for A: E1 started from a different (PCA) initialization and from a pack that cut 352 traces

B.scheme: stage2.reasoning_master@v1 (configs/stages/stage-2/reasoning_data/corpus_spec.json): verified-correct teacher-native targets, reasoning 0.70 / supporting 0.30 of unique supervised positions
B.quotas: plans/h1_accounting.json :: quotas_arm_B (supervised-token target, estimated independent units per stratum)
B.families_and_strata: 32 calibration-split rule families over 10 generators (35 less the 3 isolation rule R9 excludes as computing evaluation-only rules); three difficulty levels in equal task counts per generator cell (data/stages/stage-2/reasoning_data/tasks/train_tasks_v2.manifest.json); external modules only if approved (corpus variant stage2.reasoning_master@v1, else @v1-project-only)
B.interactive_coverage: about 18 independent episodes at 2.96M (16.7k supervised tokens per accepted episode): thin, reported as such, and the interactive axis is secondary for this reason; repeated episode prefixes are context, never counted as supervision
B.corpus_variant: chosen explicitly from corpus_spec.json :: variants; a dropped source means the other variant and its own id, never a silent fallback (plans/source_plan.json)
B.admission: whole units only: an episode any of whose turns fails or does not fit is excluded entirely, with the reason (build_master_ladder.render_all)
B.quality: aadistill.data.target_quality v2: answer with its scope; text consistency and action legality as observations; steps not_assessed unless a step checker exists (PrOntoQA reference proof: partial at best); an illegal action rejects an episode

fixed.implementation: one git commit for every unit; the same trainer, pack reader and evaluation

matched_budget.primary_basis: M1 (plans/h1_accounting.json :: primary_basis): one step count T for both arms by aadistill.training.accounting.match_schedule; U equal within 1% by the ladder cut; E and steps per seed computed exactly on the real packs; C NOT matched and reported
matched_budget.why_not_more: with A's packing efficiency at 0.355 and B's at about 0.97, U, steps and FLOPs cannot all be equal; U and steps are controlled because they are what training sees and how often it updates, C differs by about 1.22x (A higher) and is reported with its cause
matched_budget.quota_tolerance: a rung is a prefix of whole units, so U overshoots its target by less than one unit (< 0.6% at 2.96M); a preregistered |U_A - U_B| <= 1% of 2.96M
matched_budget.estimated_values: plans/h1_accounting.json :: contracts.M1_matched (A measured, B ESTIMATED): provisional T 625, A 7 / B 2 blocks per step; NOT frozen
matched_budget.schedule: plans/h1_accounting.json :: schedule -- computed by the rule on B's REAL pack (h1_accounting --pack-b), with the exact per-seed U/E/steps of both arms and a rerun cost forecast, before the protocol is frozen; the 0.86M recipe's 1,023 steps are not reused
counting_rules: one accepted trace per task: several teacher traces of one prompt are one unit and only one is trained
turn-expanded context (an episode's earlier turns, a conversation's earlier messages) is computed, never counted in U
reasoning and answer positions reported separately in U and E
reported_for_every_unit: the trainer's own train_step log (logical_block_tokens, executed_positions, executed_nonpad_tokens, supervised_tokens)
matched_budget.matching_rule: match_schedule/v1, fixed before B's pack exists: the pack with fewer blocks keeps 2 blocks per step; T searched within +-10% of its 3-epoch step count to keep every pack's passes closest to 3; each pack takes the integer blocks per step nearest 3 x blocks / T; both run exactly T steps
matched_budget.kd_positions: reported per arm by kind under kd_scope all: prompt / reasoning / answer (plans/h1_accounting.json :: contracts.*.KD_positions_per_pass and exact_per_seed)

evaluation.set: eval-set-1, frozen identity 2 (62a1a5d3...), git-backed; every item of every unit generated; scorer protocol v2, action protocol v2; validity mask v1; greedy at the trained 8,192 context; degeneration abort recorded as right-censored
evaluation.exposure: fluid_reasoning_720 is development-exposed, not a blind set; stage3_legacy_150 is in-sample regression only, never a generalization claim; no item is changed, no set is added
reported_separately: the two generator tiers: 5 evaluation-only generators (190 static + 48 episodes, unseen FORMAT) and 10 shared generators' held-out families (380 static + 96 episodes, unseen RULE, seen format)
teacher-forced diagnostics, CE and KL (diagnostics only, never a reasoning result)
evaluation.diagnostic_chain: usable output -> answer submitted in protocol (boxed answer present / legal action) -> actually correct -> correct on the unseen-format tier. Gains in the first two alone are NOT reasoning transfer.

statistics.primary_comparison: formal fluid static correctness over 570 items, B minus A, item-paired within seed and pooled over the two seeds
statistics.independence: an item is a measurement unit, not a seed-item pair: two seeds on one item are two observations of ONE item; resampling clusters by rule family, with items in one equivalence group (fluid_reasoning_720/independence_v1.json) never split
statistics.interval: two-sided 95% percentile interval, rule-family cluster bootstrap stratified by axis (aadistill.evaluation.paired_stats.cluster_bootstrap), 10,000 resamples, bootstrap seed 20261022; covers evaluation sampling only

labels.NOT_RESOLVED: resolution fails, or both arms below 2% (flag FLOOR): no equivalence, no exclusion of a gain, no GO
labels.GO: interval wholly above +0.05 AND each seed's point estimate above +0.05
labels.REVERSED: interval wholly below -0.05 AND each seed below -0.05
labels.NO-GO: interval wholly inside (-0.05, +0.05), each seed inside, AND neither arm below 2%
labels.FLOOR_A / FLOOR_B: a flag beside any label when one arm alone is below 2%; a GO off the floor is still a GO

statistics.multiplicity: one primary test; the five per-axis contrasts are secondary and Holm-adjusted as a family; the generator tiers, supporting units and guard rails are reported with unadjusted intervals and labelled descriptive
statistics.seeds: reported per seed and pooled; seed variation is NOT inside the interval and no stability claim beyond two seeds is made; no seed is selected
statistics.decided_before_results: every rule above is fixed at preregistration, before any H1 result is read
statistics.aggregation: per item, d = mean over the two seeds of (B correct - A correct); the statistic is the item-weighted mean of d
statistics.seed_condition: every directional label (GO, REVERSED, NO_GO) requires each seed's own point estimate on its side
statistics.resolution: an interval supports equivalence or the exclusion of a gain only with >= 10 discordant (item, seed) pairs in >= 5 clusters and a non-degenerate bootstrap; otherwise NOT_RESOLVED -- an all-zero or sparse result's [0, 0] is never read as equivalence
statistics.floor_does_not_gate: old A need not leave the floor before H1 runs

steps.optional_diagnostic_before_formal: a single-seed, reduced-size run of B is allowed as an ENGINEERING/DIAGNOSTIC step in a later application; it is not a confirmation, does not select a seed, and does not cancel H1 if it sits at the floor
steps.formal: both arms at both seeds (4 units), all run once launched; no early stop on A or B being at the floor
steps.if_B_at_floor: if B passes its quality audit and still sits fully at the floor after reasonable coverage and optimization diagnostics, an independent H3 diagnostic is proposed (plans/h3_candidates.json) -- not a larger ladder, and a short-budget failure is not called proof the route fails

gpu_questions_for_a_small_validation: truncate_padding ON under the frozen recipe: loss agreement with OFF on the same blocks (mathematically identical, not bitwise) and throughput
7 blocks per step (arm A) versus 2 (arm B): memory, step time and the train_step accounting fields
the new pack format through train_stage3.py on a real GPU, including a mid-training resume (no GPU resume in the middle of training is recorded yet)
evaluation time for a student that reasons at length (the forecast assumes 2x the floor-student time)
not_claimed: that correctness filtering, mixture or packing alone causes a difference
fluid-reasoning gains from lower loss, lower KL or higher usable rollout
unseen-format transfer from the shared-generator tier
that D4 is the best initialization (it is the maintainer's fixed starting point)
